description: This file contains a set of unit test methods for rendering tables using the MigraDoc library. It demonstrates creating tables with borders, cell merging, and vertical alignment, and rendering the document as a PDF.

classes.name: TestTable
classes.description: A class providing static methods as unit tests to demonstrate table rendering functionalities with the MigraDoc library.

methods.name: Borders
methods.description: Creates a document with a table that has visible borders and saves it to the specified output file.

methods.name: CellMerge
methods.description: Creates a document with a table demonstrating cell merging in horizontal and vertical directions, saving the result to the specified output file.

methods.name: VerticalAlign
methods.description: Creates a document with a table with vertically centered cells and saves it to the specified output file.
